reference.title: A holo sticker on a notebook (copies bar 10-foil-card)

alive.rests: The sticker lies still on a still notebook page: nothing moves without the pointer, and foil colour never moves with the clock (bar 10's reason, copied)

beats: A ruled notebook page lies under one key light: faint ruled lines, a margin line and punched holes down the left edge, with a few handwritten-style notes on the lines
A round die-cut sticker sits on the page, raised a little: its paper border has its own tone, and the key gives it a lit edge and a shadow that falls away from the light
The sticker's centre is holographic foil with concentric grooves about a seeded point, so under the key each part of the rings shows its own grating colour
Moving the pointer tilts the page and turns the key toward it, so the colour sweeps round the rings and the shadow follows the light
A printed star and ring cover the foil where they print; nothing moves without the pointer, and the tilt eases back to flat when the pointer leaves
